translations.literal: Its separate bureaus included the Astronomical Observatory and the Bureau for Testing the Armillary Sphere and Clepsydra, which managed day-and-night observation of celestial phenomena from the Armillary Sphere Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Separate bureaus included the Astronomical Observatory and the Bureau for Testing the Armillary Sphere and Clepsydra, which conducted round-the-clock observation of the heavens from the armillary-sphere terrace.

sentences.zh: 鐘鼓院，掌文德殿鐘鼓樓刻漏進牌之事。

translations.literal: The Bell and Drum Court managed the clepsydra, time tablets, and bell-and-drum announcements of the Wende Hall bell-and-drum tower.
translations.idiomatic: The Bell and Drum Court managed the clepsydra, time tablets, and bell-and-drum signals of the Wende Hall bell-and-drum tower.

sentences.zh: 印曆所，掌雕印曆書。

translations.literal: The Calendar Printing Office managed carving and printing of calendar books.
translations.idiomatic: The Calendar Printing Office carved and printed the official calendars.

sentences.zh: 南渡後，並同隸秘書省，長、貳、丞、郎輪季點檢。

translations.literal: After the southward relocation, all were likewise subordinate to the Secretariat; its Director, Deputy Directors, Vice Director, and Section Chiefs took turns seasonally inspecting.
translations.idiomatic: After the court moved south, all were placed under the Secretariat, whose director, deputies, vice director, and section chiefs inspected them in seasonal rotation.

sentences.zh: 元豐七年，詔四選命官通算學者，許於吏部就試，其合格者，上等除博士，中、次為學 諭。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuanfeng, an edict allowed civil officials from the four selection categories versed in mathematical learning to test at the Ministry of Personnel; those who passed were appointed Superintendent at the top grade and Instructor at the middle and lower grades.
translations.idiomatic: In 1084 civil officials from the four selection tracks who were versed in mathematics were permitted to sit for examination at the Ministry of Personnel; top passes were appointed superintendents, middle and lower passes instructors.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年初，議者謂：「本監雖準朝旨造算學，元未興工，其試選學官亦未有應格 。

translations.literal: Early in the first year of Yuanyou, memorializers said: "Although this directorate was ordered under court directive to build the Mathematical School, construction had never begun, and no candidates for the school-official examination had yet met the standard.
translations.idiomatic: Early in 1086 memorializers argued: "Although this directorate was ordered to build a mathematical school, construction never began, and no candidate in the school-official examination has yet met the standard.

sentences.zh: 竊慮徒有煩費，乞罷修建。」

translations.literal: We fear this is merely wasted effort and beg that construction be halted."
translations.idiomatic: We fear this would only waste resources and ask that construction be halted."

sentences.zh: 崇寧三年，遂將元豐算學條制修成敕令。

translations.idiomatic: In 1104 the Yuanfeng regulations for the mathematical school were revised into statutory commands.

sentences.zh: 五年，罷算學 ，令附於國子監。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Mathematical School was abolished and attached to the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In 1106 the mathematical school was abolished and placed under the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 十一月，從薛昂請，復置算學。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, at Xue Ang's request, the Mathematical School was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, at Xue Ang's request, the mathematical school was reestablished.

sentences.zh: 大觀三年，太常寺考究，以黃帝為先 師，自常先、力牧至周王朴以上從祀，凡七十人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daguan, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices investigated and took the Yellow Emperor as Chief Master, with Chang Xian, Li Mu, through Wang Pu of Zhou enshrined secondarily—a total of seventy men.
translations.idiomatic: In 1109 the Court of Imperial Sacrifices investigated and made the Yellow Emperor chief master, with Chang Xian, Li Mu, and others through Wang Pu of Zhou enshrined as secondary associates—seventy men in all.

sentences.zh: 四年，以算學生併入太史局。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, mathematical students were merged into the Imperial Astronomical Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In 1110 mathematical students were merged into the Imperial Astronomical Bureau.

sentences.zh: 宣和二 年，詔並罷官吏。

translations.idiomatic: In 1120 an edict abolished all its officials and clerks.

translations.idiomatic: Palace Domestic Service: superintendent, vice superintendent, superintendent, vice director

translations.idiomatic: Each of the six bureaus had two chief stewards, four or six attendants-in-attendance, and one or two gate supervisors.

sentences.zh: 又尚食有膳工，尚藥有醫師， 尚醞有酒工，尚衣有衣徒，尚舍有幕士，尚輦有正供等，皆分隸其局。）〉

translations.idiomatic: One commissioner over the six bureaus and one managing official were also established.

translations.literal: Formerly one person handled Secretariat affairs of the Palace Domestic Service, filled by court officials without substantive duties.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly one official handled Palace Domestic Service secretariat affairs, filled by court officials without substantive posts.

translations.idiomatic: Although the six bureaus existed in name, their functions remained separate; officials followed their bureau and were not directed by this directorate.

translations.idiomatic: while the superintendent of the Palace Domestic Service merely held the Secretariat post as a salary-conferring sinecure.

sentences.zh: 元豐中，神宗欲復建此官，而度 禁中未有其地，但詔御輦院不隸省寺，令專達焉。

translations.literal: In the Yuanfeng period Emperor Shenzong wished to restore this office, but gauging that there was no place for it within the inner palace, he only ordered that the Imperial Carriage Court not be subordinate to directorates and temples but report directly.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanfeng era Shenzong wished to restore the office, but finding no space for it within the inner palace, he ordered only that the Imperial Carriage Court not be subordinate to directorates and temples but report directly to court.

sentences.zh: 初，權太府卿林顏因按內藏庫，見乘 輿服御雜貯百物中，乃乞復殿中省六尚，以嚴奉至尊。

translations.literal: At first, Acting Superintendent of the Court of the Imperial Treasury Lin Yan, on inspecting the Inner Storehouse, saw among the myriad items stored with imperial carriages and apparel, and therefore requested restoration of the Six Bureaus of the Palace Domestic Service to honorably serve the Supreme One.
translations.idiomatic: At first Acting Superintendent of the Court of the Imperial Treasury Lin Yan, while inspecting the Inner Storehouse, found imperial carriages, apparel, and countless other goods jumbled together and petitioned to restore the six bureaus of the Palace Domestic Service so that service to the sovereign might be kept in proper order.

sentences.zh: 於是徽宗乃出先朝所度殿中省圖 ，命三省行之，而其法皆左正言姚祐所裁定，是歲崇寧二年也。

translations.literal: Thereupon Huizong produced the plan for the Palace Domestic Service gauged in earlier reigns and ordered the Three Departments to implement it; its regulations were all determined by Left Remonstrance Official Yao You—in that year, the second year of Chongning.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Huizong produced the plan for the Palace Domestic Service drawn up in earlier reigns and ordered the Three Departments to implement it; Yao You, Left Remonstrance Official, determined all its regulations—in 1103.

sentences.zh: 三年，蔡京上修成殿中 省六尚局供奉庫務敕令格式並看詳凡六十卷，仍冠以「崇寧」為名。

translations.literal: In the third year, Cai Jing submitted the completed statutes, formats, and review summaries for the Six Bureaus of the Palace Domestic Service and their supply repositories—a total of sixty juan—still prefixed with "Chongning" as the name.
translations.idiomatic: In 1104 Cai Jing submitted the completed statutes, formats, and review summaries for the six bureaus of the Palace Domestic Service and their supply repositories—sixty juan in all—still bearing the Chongning prefix.

sentences.zh: 政和元年，殿中省高 伸上編定六尚供奉式。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhenghe, Gao Shen of the Palace Domestic Service submitted the compiled formulas for Six-Bureau supply.
translations.idiomatic: In 1111 Gao Shen of the Palace Domestic Service submitted the compiled formulas for six-bureau supply.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年，詔六尚局並依祖宗法。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingkang, an edict ordered the Six Bureaus all to follow ancestral law.
translations.idiomatic: In 1126 an edict ordered the six bureaus to follow ancestral practice.

translations.idiomatic: Another edict read: "Now that the six bureaus have been abolished,

translations.idiomatic: Imperial Pharmacy

translations.idiomatic: Managing officials had no fixed quota and were filled by inner-palace eunuchs of the Palace Domestic Service.

translations.idiomatic: It verified secret formulas, compounded medicines on schedule, and supplied drugs for the emperor and the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 掌受錦綺、雜帛、衣服之物， 以備給賜及邦國儀注之用，並受納衣服以賜諸司丁匠、諸軍。

translations.literal: managed receipt of brocades, miscellaneous silks, and garments to prepare for bestowal and for state ritual use, and also received garments to grant to artisan conscripts of various offices and to the armies.
translations.idiomatic: received brocades, miscellaneous silks, and garments for bestowals and state ritual use, and also received garments to grant to artisan conscripts of various offices and to the armies.

sentences.zh: 監門二人，以三班使臣充 。

translations.literal: Two gate supervisors, filled by third-rank envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Two gate supervisors were filled by third-rank envoys.

sentences.zh: 典十人，掌庫五十五人。

translations.literal: Ten custodians, fifty-five repository keepers.
translations.idiomatic: It had ten custodians and fifty-five repository keepers.

sentences.zh: 朝服、法物庫

translations.literal: Court Dress and Ritual Objects Repository
translations.idiomatic: Court Dress and Ritual Objects Repository

sentences.zh: （太平興國二年置，後分三庫：一在天安殿後，一在右掖門內北廊，一在正陽門外。）〉

translations.literal: Established in the second year of Taiping Xingguo; later divided into three repositories: one behind Tian'an Hall, one in the north corridor inside the Right Flank Gate, one outside the Main Yang Gate.)
translations.idiomatic: Established in 977; later divided into three repositories—one behind Tian'an Hall, one in the north corridor inside the Right Flank Gate, and one outside the Main Yang Gate.)

sentences.zh: 監官二人，以諸司使、副及三班、內侍充，掌百官朝服、諸司儀仗之名物。

translations.literal: Two supervising officials, filled by commissioners and deputies of various offices, third rank, and eunuchs, managed court dress of the hundred officials and ritual paraphernalia of various offices.
translations.idiomatic: Two supervising officials, drawn from commissioners and deputies of various offices, third-rank officers, and eunuchs, managed court dress for the hundred officials and ritual paraphernalia for the various offices.

sentences.zh: 典三人，掌 庫三十人。

translations.literal: Three custodians, thirty repository keepers.
translations.idiomatic: It had three custodians and thirty repository keepers.

sentences.zh: 已上崇寧二年併入殿中省。

translations.literal: All the above were merged into the Palace Domestic Service in the second year of Chongning.
translations.idiomatic: All of the above were merged into the Palace Domestic Service in 1103.

sentences.zh: （舊有裁造院、針線院、雜賣場，後省併之。）〉

translations.literal: Formerly there were the Tailoring Court, the Needlework Court, and the Miscellaneous Mart; later these were merged and abolished.)
translations.idiomatic: There had formerly been the Tailoring Court, the Needlework Court, and the Miscellaneous Mart; later they were consolidated.)

sentences.zh: 太常寺 卿 少卿 丞各一人 博士四人

translations.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices: Minister, Vice Minister, Vice Director one each; Masters of Ceremony four.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices had one minister, one vice minister, one vice director, and four masters of ceremony.

sentences.zh: 主簿、協律郎、奉禮郎、太祝各一人。

translations.literal: Registrar, Harmonizing Pitch Officer, Ritual Attendant, and Grand Sacrificer one each.
translations.idiomatic: It had one registrar, one harmonizing pitch officer, one ritual attendant, and one grand sacrificer.

sentences.zh: 卿掌禮樂、郊廟、社稷、壇壝、陵寢之事，少卿 為之貳，丞參領之。

translations.literal: The Minister managed rites and music, suburban and temple sacrifices, altars of soil and grain, ritual mounds, and imperial tombs; the Vice Minister was second; the Vice Director assisted.
translations.idiomatic: The minister oversaw rites and music, suburban and temple sacrifices, altars of soil and grain, ritual precincts, and imperial tombs; the vice minister was second in rank; the vice director assisted.

sentences.zh: 禮之名有五：曰吉禮，曰賓禮，曰軍禮，曰嘉禮，曰凶禮。

translations.literal: The names of rites are five: auspicious rites, guest rites, military rites, felicitous rites, and inauspicious rites.
translations.idiomatic: Rites were classified in five kinds: auspicious, guest, military, felicitous, and inauspicious.

sentences.zh: 皆掌其 制度儀式。

translations.literal: It managed their regulations and ceremonial forms in all cases.
translations.idiomatic: It regulated the statutes and ceremonial forms for all of them.

sentences.zh: 祭祀有大祠，有小祠。

translations.literal: Sacrifices had great offerings and minor offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial observances were divided into major and minor offerings.

sentences.zh: 其犧牲、幣玉、酒醴、薦獻、器服各辨其等；

translations.literal: Victims, silk and jade, wines and libations, presentation offerings, and ritual vessels and garb—each grade was distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Victims, silk and jade, wines, presentation offerings, and ritual vessels and vestments were each assigned to its proper grade.

sentences.zh: 掌樂律 、樂舞、樂章以定宮架、特架之制，祭祀享則分樂而序之。

translations.literal: It managed pitch standards, dance music, and hymn texts to fix the palace-frame and special-frame systems; when sacrifices were presented, music was apportioned and sequenced.
translations.idiomatic: It governed pitch standards, dance music, and hymn texts to establish the palace-frame and special-frame arrangements; at sacrificial presentations it allotted and sequenced the music.

sentences.zh: 凡親祠及四孟月朝獻景靈宮 、郊祀告享太廟，掌贊相禮儀升降之節。

translations.literal: For all imperial sacrifices, the four first-month offerings at Jingling Palace, and suburban sacrifices announcing offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, it directed the timing of ascent and descent in ritual.
translations.idiomatic: For imperial sacrifices in person, the four first-month offerings at Jingling Palace, and suburban sacrifices announcing offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, it prompted the cadence of ritual ascent and descent.

sentences.zh: 歲時朝拜陵寢，則視法式辨具以授祠官。

translations.literal: For seasonal visits to imperial tombs, it inspected the statutory forms, distinguished and prepared what was needed, and entrusted it to sacrifice officers.
translations.idiomatic: For seasonal visits to imperial tombs, it inspected the prescribed forms, distinguished and prepared what was required, and handed it to the sacrificial officers.

sentences.zh: 凡祠 事，差官、卜日、齋戒皆檢舉以聞。

translations.literal: For all sacrificial affairs, assigning officers, divining dates, and purification fasting—all were investigated and reported.
translations.idiomatic: For every sacrificial affair—assigning officers, divining the day, and fasting purification—it investigated and reported to court.

sentences.zh: 初獻用執政官，則卿為終獻，用卿，則少卿為亞獻 ；

translations.literal: If the chief presenter was a chief councillor, the Minister was final presenter; if the Minister served, the Vice Minister was secondary presenter;
translations.idiomatic: If a chief councillor made the first offering, the minister made the final offering; if the minister made the first offering, the vice minister made the second offering;

sentences.zh: 博士為終獻；

translations.literal: the Master of Ceremony was final presenter;
translations.idiomatic: the master of ceremony made the final offering;

sentences.zh: 闕則以次互攝。

translations.literal: if posts were vacant they filled in by rank in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: if a post was vacant, officers of lower rank filled in by turns.

sentences.zh: 郊祀已，頒御札則撰儀以進。

translations.literal: After suburban sacrifice, when an imperial directive was issued, it drafted the ritual and submitted it.
translations.idiomatic: After a suburban sacrifice, when an imperial directive was issued, it drafted the ritual protocol and submitted it.

sentences.zh: 宮架、鼓吹、警場，率前 期按閱即習。

translations.literal: Palace-frame music, wind-and-drum music, and guard formations—as a rule were reviewed and rehearsed on schedule beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: Palace-frame ensembles, wind-and-drum music, and guard formations were as a rule reviewed and rehearsed on schedule beforehand.

sentences.zh: 餘祀及朝會、宴享、上壽、封冊之儀物亦如之。

translations.literal: Other sacrifices and the regalia for court assemblies, banquets, longevity celebrations, and investiture were handled likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Other sacrifices and the ritual objects for court assemblies, banquets, longevity celebrations, and investiture were handled in the same way.

sentences.zh: 若禮樂有所損益，及祀典 、神祀、爵號與封襲、繼嗣之事當考定者，擬上於禮部。

translations.literal: If rites and music were to be increased or reduced, or if the canon of sacrifice, spirit worship, titles, enfeoffment and succession required determination, proposals were submitted to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: If rites and music were to be revised, or if the canon of sacrifice, cults of spirits, titles, enfeoffment, and succession required determination, it drafted proposals to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 凡太醫之政令，以時頒行。

translations.literal: All medical ordinances of the Imperial Physicians were issued on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: All ordinances of the Imperial Physicians were promulgated on schedule.

sentences.zh: 宋初，舊置判寺無常員，以兩制以上充，丞一人，以禮官久次官高者充。

translations.literal: Early in the Song, a court-assigned director of the court was established without fixed quota, filled by officials of the two academies and above; one vice director, filled by a veteran ritual official of high standing.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Song a court-assigned director was established without a fixed quota, filled by officials of the two academies and above; one vice director was filled by a senior ritual official of long service.

sentences.zh: 別置太常禮院 ，雖隸本寺，其實專達。

translations.literal: A separate Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Academy was established; though subordinate to this court, in fact it reported directly.
translations.idiomatic: A separate Ritual Academy of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was also established; though nominally subordinate to the court, in practice it reported directly to the throne.

sentences.zh: 有判院、同知院四人，寺與禮院事不相兼。

translations.literal: There were four court-assigned directors and associate directors; duties of the court and the academy were not combined.
translations.idiomatic: It had four court-assigned directors and associate directors; the court and the academy did not combine their duties.

sentences.zh: 康定元年，置判寺 、同判寺，始並兼禮院事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangding, court-assigned director and associate director were established, and duties of the academy were first combined.
translations.idiomatic: In 1040 court-assigned director and associate director were established, and they first combined the academy's duties with those of the court.

sentences.zh: 元豐正名，始專其職。

translations.literal: At the Yuanfeng rectification of titles, its duties were first made exclusive.
translations.idiomatic: At the Yuanfeng rectification of titles in 1085, its officers were first assigned exclusive duties.

sentences.zh: 公案五，置吏十有一。

translations.literal: Five case desks; eleven clerks established.
translations.idiomatic: It had five case desks and eleven clerks.

sentences.zh: 元祐三年，詔 太常寺置長貳，他寺監則互置。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanyou, an edict ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to have dedicated director and deputies; other courts and directorates were to rotate them.
translations.idiomatic: In 1088 an edict required the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to have its own director and deputies, while other courts and directorates were to share theirs in rotation.

sentences.zh: 紹聖中，復舊制。

translations.literal: During Shaosheng, the old system was restored.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaosheng era the former system was restored.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年，應太常寺所被旨及施行典 禮事，季輪博士銓次成籍，以備討論。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daguan, whenever the Court of Imperial Sacrifices received imperial directives and implemented canonical rites, doctors each quarter compiled registers in order for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In 1107, whenever the Court of Imperial Sacrifices received imperial directives and carried out canonical rites, the doctors each quarter compiled ordered registers for reference and discussion.

sentences.zh: 政和四年令，祠事監察御史闕，則以六曹郎官及 館職攝充。

translations.literal: An order of the fourth year of Zhenghe: if the surveillance censor for sacrifices was vacant, section chiefs of the six departments and academy fellows served pro tem.
translations.idiomatic: A directive of 1114 provided that if the surveillance censor for sacrifices was vacant, section chiefs of the six departments and academy fellows would serve in his stead.

sentences.zh: 宣和三年，令本寺因革禮五年一檢，舉接續編修。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuanhe, this court was ordered to inspect ritual reforms every five years and compile revisions continuously.
translations.idiomatic: In 1121 the court was ordered to review changes in ritual every five years and to compile successive revisions without interruption.

sentences.zh: 建炎初，併省冗職，惟太 常、大理不並。

translations.literal: Early in Jianyan, redundant posts were merged and reduced; only the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Court of Justice were not merged.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jianyan era redundant posts were cut; only the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Court of Justice were left unmerged.

sentences.zh: 詔太常少卿一員兼宗正少卿，罷丞、簿，惟置博士一員。

translations.literal: An edict ordered one vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices also to serve as vice minister of the Court of the Imperial Clan; the vice director and registrar were abolished; only one master of ceremony was retained.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed one vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to double as vice minister of the Court of the Imperial Clan; the vice director and registrar were abolished, and only one master of ceremony was retained.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，復 置丞。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, the vice director was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In 1133 the vice director was restored.

sentences.zh: 九年，臣僚言：「元豐正名，太常主議論者博士四人，乞參稽舊典，添置博士， 以稱朝廷蒐補闕軼、緝熙彌文之意。」

translations.literal: In the ninth year, officials memorialized: "At the Yuanfeng rectification of titles the Court of Imperial Sacrifices had four doctors who chaired deliberation. We beg reference to old statutes to add doctors, in keeping with the court's intent to gather and repair omissions and ever more brightly adorn culture."
translations.idiomatic: In 1139 officials memorialized: "After the Yuanfeng rectification of titles the Court of Imperial Sacrifices had four doctors who led deliberation. We ask that the old statutes be consulted and additional doctors appointed, in keeping with the court's aim to gather what is missing, repair what is broken, and ever more brightly adorn the civil order."

sentences.zh: 詔添博士一員。

translations.literal: An edict added one master of ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: An edict added one master of ceremony.

sentences.zh: 十年，置簿一員。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, one registrar was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1140 one registrar was established.

sentences.zh: 十五年，詔太 常討論置籍田令，續置太社令。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, an edict ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to deliberate on establishing a Registrar of the Royal Fields and further to establish a Registrar of the Grand Altar of Soil.
translations.idiomatic: In 1145 an edict ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to deliberate on establishing a registrar of the royal fields and then to establish a registrar of the Grand Altar of Soil.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年，併省博士一員，主簿一員，又以光祿寺並歸 太常，罷丞。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing, one doctor and one registrar were merged and reduced; the Court of Imperial Entertainments was also merged into the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and the vice director was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 1163 one doctor and one registrar were cut; the Court of Imperial Entertainments was merged into the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and the vice director was abolished.

sentences.zh: 明年，詔丞、簿並依舊制。

translations.literal: The following year, an edict restored the vice director and registrar according to the old system.
translations.idiomatic: The following year an edict restored the vice director and registrar under the former system.

sentences.zh: 博士掌講定五禮儀式，有改革則據經審議。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremony lectured on and fixed the ceremonial forms of the five rites; if reforms were proposed, he deliberated on the basis of the classics.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremony lectured on and fixed the ceremonial forms of the five rites; proposed reforms were debated with reference to the classics.

sentences.zh: 凡於法應諡者，考其行狀，撰定諡文。

translations.literal: For all who by law merited a posthumous title, he examined the conduct record and drafted the title text.
translations.idiomatic: For all who by law merited a posthumous title, he examined the conduct record and drafted the epithet.

sentences.zh: 有祠 事，則監視儀物，掌凡贊導之事。

translations.literal: When there were sacrifices, he oversaw ritual objects and managed all prompting and guidance.
translations.idiomatic: At sacrifices he oversaw ritual objects and directed all prompting and guidance in the rite.

sentences.zh: 主簿，掌稽考簿書。

translations.literal: The Registrar audited ledgers and documents.
translations.idiomatic: The registrar audited ledgers and documents.

sentences.zh: 協律郎，掌律、呂以和陰陽之聲，正宮架、特架樂舞之位。

translations.literal: The Harmonizing Pitch Officer managed the pitch pipes to harmonize the sounds of yin and yang and fixed the positions of palace-frame and special-frame dance music.
translations.idiomatic: The harmonizing pitch officer governed the pitch pipes to harmonize yin and yang in sound and fixed the positions of palace-frame and special-frame dance music.

sentences.zh: 大祭祀享宴用樂，則執麾以 詔作止之節，舉麾、鼓柷而樂作；

translations.literal: At great sacrifices, banquets, and presentations with music, he held the baton to signal the cadence of starting and stopping; raising the baton and striking the sounding-block, music began;
translations.idiomatic: At great sacrifices, banquets, and presentations with music, he held the baton to signal when music should begin and cease; when he raised the baton and struck the sounding-block, the music began;

sentences.zh: 偃麾、戛敔而樂止。

translations.literal: lowering the baton and striking the clapper, music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: when he lowered the baton and struck the clapper, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 凡樂，掌其序事。

translations.literal: For all music, he managed its sequencing.
translations.idiomatic: For all musical performances he managed their order and arrangement.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎，掌奉幣帛授初獻官，大禮則設親祠板位。

translations.literal: The Ritual Attendant presented silk and offered it to the chief presenter; at great rites he set the panels for imperial sacrifice in person.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendant presented silk and handed it to the chief presenter; at great rites he set out the panels for sacrifices performed by the emperor in person.

sentences.zh: 太祝，掌讀冊辭，授摶黍以嘏告，飲福則進爵，酌酒受其虛爵。

translations.literal: The Grand Sacrificer read the text on the tablets, presented kneaded millet for the blessing announcement; at the drinking of fortune he advanced the cup, poured wine, and received the empty cup.
translations.idiomatic: The grand sacrificer read the text on the tablets, presented kneaded millet for the blessing invocation; at the drinking of fortune he advanced the cup, poured the wine, and received back the emptied cup.

sentences.zh: 郊社令，掌巡視四郊及社稷。

translations.literal: The Registrar of Suburban and Soil Altars inspected the four suburbs and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: The registrar of suburban and soil altars inspected the four suburbs and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 壇壝，掌凡掃除之事，祭祀則省牲。

translations.literal: The Altar Mound Custodian managed all sweeping and cleaning; at sacrifices he inspected the victims.
translations.idiomatic: The altar-mound custodian managed sweeping and cleaning; at sacrifices he inspected the victims.

sentences.zh: 太廟令，掌宗廟薦新七祀及功臣從享之禮。

translations.literal: The Registrar of the Imperial Ancestral Temple managed seasonal offerings, the seven regular sacrifices, and the rites for associated worthies sharing the temple.
translations.idiomatic: The registrar of the Imperial Ancestral Temple managed seasonal offerings, the seven regular sacrifices, and the rites by which meritorious ministers shared in the temple cult.

sentences.zh: 籍田令，掌帝籍耕耨出納之事，植五穀蔬果，藏冰以待用。

translations.literal: The Registrar of the Royal Fields managed ploughing, hoeing, receipt, and disbursement on the emperor's field; he planted the five grains and fruits and vegetables and stored ice against need.
translations.idiomatic: The registrar of the royal fields managed ploughing, cultivation, and receipts and disbursements on the emperor's ceremonial field; he planted the five grains, fruits, and vegetables and stored ice for later use.

sentences.zh: 宮闈令，率其屬以汛灑廟庭，凡修治潔除之事。

translations.literal: The Registrar of the Palace Precinct led his subordinates in sprinkling temple courts and managed all repair, cleansing, and purification.
translations.idiomatic: The registrar of the palace precinct led his staff in sprinkling the temple courts and oversaw all repair, cleansing, and purification.

sentences.zh: 提點管幹郊廟祭器所 南郊太廟祭器庫 提點朝服法物庫所 朝服法物庫 南郊什物庫 太廟什物庫 掌藏其器服，以待祭祀、朝會之用。

translations.literal: The Intendant Managing the Suburban and Temple Sacrificial Vessels Office, the Southern Suburb and Imperial Ancestral Temple Sacrificial Vessel Depots, the Intendant of the Court Robes and Ritual Objects Office, the Court Robes and Ritual Objects Depot, the Southern Suburb Sundries Depot, and the Imperial Ancestral Temple Sundries Depot stored vessels and vestments against use in sacrifice and court assembly.
translations.idiomatic: The intendant managing suburban and temple sacrificial vessels, the southern suburb and Imperial Ancestral Temple sacrificial vessel depots, the intendant of court robes and ritual objects, the court robes and ritual objects depot, the southern suburb sundries depot, and the Imperial Ancestral Temple sundries depot stored ritual vessels and vestments for sacrifices and court assemblies.

sentences.zh: 凡冠服，視其等而頒於執事之臣。

translations.literal: For all caps and robes, according to rank they were issued to officiating ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Caps and robes were issued to officiating ministers according to their rank.

sentences.zh: 教坊及鈐轄教坊所掌宴樂閱習，以待宴享之用，考其藝而進退之。

translations.literal: The Music Office and the Directorate Overseeing the Music Office managed rehearsal of banquet music against use at banquets and assessed performers' skill for promotion and dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office and the directorate overseeing it rehearsed banquet music for court feasts and assessed performers' skill to promote or dismiss them.

sentences.zh: 諸陵祠墳所 掌先世后妃之墳園而以時獻享。

translations.literal: The various imperial tomb shrine and grave offices managed the grave parks of former emperors and consorts and presented offerings on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: The various imperial tomb shrine and grave offices cared for the grave parks of former emperors and consorts and presented offerings on schedule.

sentences.zh: 太醫局

translations.literal: Imperial Medical Bureau
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Medical Bureau

sentences.zh: 有丞，有教授，有九科醫生額三百人。

translations.literal: It had a vice director, instructors, and a quota of three hundred medical students in nine specialties.
translations.idiomatic: It had a vice director and instructors, with a quota of three hundred medical students in nine specialties.

sentences.zh: 歲終則會其全失而定其賞罰。

translations.literal: At year's end it tallied successes and failures and fixed rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: At year's end it tallied cures and failures and fixed rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: （太醫局，熙寧九 年置，以知制誥熊本提舉，大理寺丞單驤管幹。

translations.literal: (The Imperial Medical Bureau was established in the ninth year of Xining, with Drafting Academician Xiong Ben as intendant and Court of Justice Vice Director Shan Qiang as managing officer.
translations.idiomatic: (The Imperial Medical Bureau was established in 1076, with Drafting Academician Xiong Ben as intendant and Court of Justice vice director Shan Qiang as managing officer.

sentences.zh: 後詔勿隸太常寺，置提舉一、判局二， 判局選知醫事者為之。

translations.literal: Later an edict ordered that it not be subordinate to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; one intendant and two bureau chiefs were established; bureau chiefs were chosen from those versed in medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Later an edict removed it from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; one intendant and two bureau chiefs were appointed, chosen from those skilled in medicine.

sentences.zh: 科置教授一，選翰林醫官以下與上等學生及在外良醫為之。

translations.literal: One instructor was established for each specialty, chosen from Hanlin medical officers and below, top-rank students, and able physicians outside the court.
translations.idiomatic: One instructor was appointed for each specialty, chosen from Hanlin medical officers, advanced students, and able physicians outside the court.

sentences.zh: 學生 常以春試，取合格者三百人為額。

translations.literal: Students were regularly examined in spring; three hundred who passed were taken as the quota.
translations.idiomatic: Students were examined each spring; three hundred passes formed the quota.

sentences.zh: 太學、律學、武學生、諸營將士疾病，輪往治之。

translations.literal: Students of the Directorate of Education, the Law School, and the Military School, and officers and soldiers of the various camps who fell ill were treated in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Students of the Directorate of Education, the law school, and the military school, and officers and soldiers of the various camps who fell ill were treated in rotation.

sentences.zh: 各 給印紙，書其狀，歲終稽其功緒，為三等第補之：上等月給錢十五千，毋過二十人；

translations.literal: Each was given stamped paper on which the case was recorded; at year's end merit was audited and ranked in three grades for stipends: the top grade received fifteen thousand cash monthly, not more than twenty persons;
translations.idiomatic: Each received stamped forms on which cases were recorded; at year's end merit was audited and stipends ranked in three grades: the top grade received fifteen thousand cash monthly, not more than twenty persons;

sentences.zh: 中 等十千，毋過三十人；

translations.literal: the middle grade ten thousand, not more than thirty persons;
translations.idiomatic: the middle grade ten thousand, not more than thirty persons;

sentences.zh: 下等五千，毋過五十人。

translations.literal: the lower grade five thousand, not more than fifty persons.
translations.idiomatic: the lower grade five thousand, not more than fifty persons.

sentences.zh: 失多者罰黜之。

translations.literal: Those with many failures were punished and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Those with many failures were punished and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 受兵校錢物者，論如監 臨強乞取法。

translations.literal: Those accepting money or goods from military officers were judged under the law on supervisors who extort by force.
translations.idiomatic: Those who accepted money or goods from military officers were prosecuted under the law on supervisors who extort by force.

sentences.zh: 三學生原預者聽受，而禁邀求者。

translations.literal: Students of the three schools who had prepaid fees might accept payment; solicitation was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Students of the three schools who had prepaid fees might accept payment, but solicitation was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 又官制行，隸太常禮部，自政和以後， 隸醫學，詳見選舉志。）〉

translations.literal: When the official system was implemented it was subordinate to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Ministry of Rites; from Zhenghe onward it was subordinate to the Medical School—see the Treatise on Selection in detail.)
translations.idiomatic: When the new official system took effect it was placed under the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Ministry of Rites; from the Zhenghe era onward it came under the medical school—see the Treatise on Selection for details.)

sentences.zh: 孝宗隆興元年，省併醫官而罷局生。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing under Emperor Xiaozong, medical officers were merged and reduced and bureau students were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 1163 under Emperor Xiaozong, medical officers were cut and bureau students were abolished.

sentences.zh: 續以虞允文請，依舊存留 醫學科，逐舉附試省試別試所，更不置局，權令太常寺掌行。

translations.literal: Subsequently, at Yu Yunwen's request, the medical specialty was retained as before; each examination cycle it was attached to the separate examination hall of the metropolitan and provincial examinations; the bureau was no longer established, and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was temporarily ordered to administer it.
translations.idiomatic: Later, at Yu Yunwen's request, the medical specialty was retained; each examination cycle it was attached to the separate hall of the metropolitan examinations; the bureau was not reestablished, and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was temporarily charged with its administration.

sentences.zh: 紹熙二年，復置太醫局， 局生以百員為額，餘並依未罷局前體例，仍隸太常寺。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxi, the Imperial Medical Bureau was reestablished; bureau students were fixed at one hundred; all else followed the regulations before the bureau was abolished; it remained subordinate to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In 1191 the Imperial Medical Bureau was reestablished with a quota of one hundred bureau students; all else followed the regulations in force before its abolition, and it remained under the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 大晟府

translations.literal: Dasheng Prefecture
translations.idiomatic: Dasheng Prefecture

sentences.zh: 以大司樂為長，典樂為貳。

translations.literal: The Grand Master of Music was chief; the Director of Music was second.
translations.idiomatic: The grand master of music was chief; the director of music was second in rank.

sentences.zh: 次曰大樂令，秩比丞。

translations.literal: Next was the Director of Great Music, rank equal to a vice director.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the director of great music, with rank equal to a vice director.

sentences.zh: 次曰主簿、協律郎。

translations.literal: Next were the Registrar and Harmonizing Pitch Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Below them were the registrar and harmonizing pitch officer.

sentences.zh: 又有按協聲律、 制撰文字、運譜等官，以京朝官、選人或白衣士人通樂律者為之。

translations.literal: There were also officers for testing and harmonizing pitch, drafting texts, and arranging scores, filled by capital officials, selected candidates, or commoners versed in musical pitch.
translations.idiomatic: There were also officers who tested and harmonized pitch, drafted texts, and arranged scores, drawn from capital officials, examination candidates, or commoners skilled in musical theory.

sentences.zh: 又以武臣監府門及大 樂法物庫，以侍從及內省近侍官提舉。

translations.literal: Military officers also supervised the prefecture gate and the depot of great-music ritual objects; attendant officials and inner-palace close attendants served as intendants.
translations.idiomatic: Military officers supervised the prefecture gate and the great-music ritual objects depot, while attendant officials and inner-palace close attendants served as intendants.

sentences.zh: 所典六案；

translations.literal: It oversaw six case desks:
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw six case desks:

sentences.zh: 曰大樂，曰鼓吹，曰宴樂，曰法物， 曰知雜，曰掌法。

translations.literal: Great Music, Wind and Drum, Banquet Music, Ritual Objects, General Affairs, and Statutory Custody.
translations.idiomatic: Great Music, Wind and Drum, Banquet Music, Ritual Objects, General Affairs, and Statutory Custody.

sentences.zh: 國朝禮、樂掌於奉常。

translations.literal: In our dynasty rites and music were managed by the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In our dynasty rites and music were managed by the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初，置局議大樂；

translations.literal: Early in Chongning, a bureau was established to deliberate on great music;
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongning era a bureau was established to deliberate on the new court music;

sentences.zh: 樂成，置府建官以司之 ，禮、樂始分為二。

translations.literal: when the music was completed, a prefecture was established and officers appointed to administer it; rites and music were first divided into two.
translations.idiomatic: when the music was completed, a prefecture was established with its own officers; rites and music were first separated.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，因省冗員，併之禮官；

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year, redundant personnel were reduced and it was merged into the ritual offices;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year redundant posts were cut and it was merged into the ritual offices;

sentences.zh: 九月，復舊。

translations.literal: in the ninth month the former arrangement was restored.
translations.idiomatic: in the ninth month the former arrangement was restored.

sentences.zh: 大觀四年，以官徒 廩給繁厚，省樂令一員、監官二員，吏祿並視太常格。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Daguan, because official stipends and grain allowances were heavy, one director of music and two supervising officers were cut; clerks' salaries followed the Court of Imperial Sacrifices standard.
translations.idiomatic: In 1110, because stipends and grain allowances were heavy, one director of music and two supervising officers were cut; clerks' salaries followed the Court of Imperial Sacrifices standard.

sentences.zh: 宣和二年，詔以大晟府近歲添置 冗濫徼幸，罷不復再置。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuanhe, an edict held that in recent years Dasheng Prefecture had added redundant posts through favor-seeking; it was abolished and not reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: In 1120 an edict declared that Dasheng Prefecture had in recent years swollen with redundant posts through favor-seeking; it was abolished and never reestablished.

sentences.zh: 宗正寺 卿 少卿 丞

translations.literal: Court of the Imperial Clan: Minister, Vice Minister, Vice Director
translations.idiomatic: Court of the Imperial Clan: minister, vice minister, vice director

sentences.zh: 主簿各一人。

translations.literal: Registrar one each.
translations.idiomatic: Each office had one registrar.

sentences.zh: 卿掌敘宗派屬籍，以別昭穆而定其親疏，少卿為之貳，丞參領之。

translations.literal: The Minister arranged clan branches and membership registers to distinguish senior and junior lines and fix degrees of kinship; the Vice Minister was second; the Vice Director assisted.
translations.idiomatic: The minister arranged clan branches and membership registers to distinguish senior and junior lines and fix degrees of kinship; the vice minister was second in rank; the vice director assisted.

sentences.zh: 凡修纂 牒、譜、圖、籍，其別有五：曰玉牒，以編年之體敘帝系而記其歷數，凡政令賞罰、封 域戶口、豐凶祥瑞之事載焉。

translations.literal: For all compilation of registers, genealogies, charts, and records, there were five kinds: the Jade Genealogy, narrating the imperial line in annalistic form and recording its reigns, with edicts, rewards and punishments, territory, households, and matters of abundance, calamity, and auspicious signs entered therein.
translations.idiomatic: Registers, genealogies, charts, and records fell into five kinds: the Jade Genealogy, which narrated the imperial line in annalistic form and recorded reign lengths, entering edicts, rewards and punishments, territory, households, and reports of abundance, calamity, and auspicious signs.

sentences.zh: 曰屬籍，序同姓之親而第其服紀之戚疏遠近。

translations.literal: the Membership Register, ordering kin of the same surname and ranking the closeness and distance of mourning obligations.
translations.idiomatic: the Membership Register, which ordered kin of the same surname and ranked them by the closeness or distance of mourning obligations.

sentences.zh: 曰宗藩慶系 錄，辨譜系之所自出，序其子孫而列其名位品秩。

translations.literal: the Record of Felicitous Lines of Enfeoffed Princes, distinguishing the origins of genealogies, ordering descendants, and listing names, offices, and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: the Record of Felicitous Lines of Enfeoffed Princes, which traced genealogical origins, ordered descendants, and listed names, offices, and ranks.

sentences.zh: 曰僊源積慶圖，考定世次枝分派別而 系以本宗。

translations.literal: the Chart of Accumulated Felicity from the Immortal Source, verifying generations, branches, and subdivisions and linking them to the main line.
translations.idiomatic: the Chart of Accumulated Felicity from the Immortal Source, which verified generations, branches, and subdivisions and linked them to the main imperial line.

sentences.zh: 曰僊源類譜，序男女宗婦族姓婚姻及官爵遷敘而著其功罪、生死。

translations.literal: the Genealogical Compendium of the Immortal Source, ordering men and women, clan wives, surnames, marriages, and the promotion and demotion of offices and ranks, and recording their merits and faults, life and death.
translations.idiomatic: the Genealogical Compendium of the Immortal Source, which ordered men and women, clan wives, surnames, and marriages, set forth the promotion and demotion of offices and ranks, and recorded merits and faults, life and death.

sentences.zh: 凡錄以一 歲，圖以三歲、牒、譜、籍以十歲修纂以進。

translations.literal: As a rule, registers were revised every one year, charts every three years, and tablets, genealogies, and membership records every ten years, then compiled and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: As a rule, registers were revised every year, charts every three years, and tablets, genealogies, and membership records every ten years, then compiled and presented.

sentences.zh: 宋初，舊置判寺事二人，以宗姓兩制以上 充，闕則以宗姓朝官以上知丞事。

translations.literal: In early Song, two supervisors of court affairs had formerly been established, filled by members of the imperial clan at drafted-edict rank and above; when vacant, a member of the imperial clan at court-official rank and above managed vice-director duties.
translations.idiomatic: In early Song two supervisors of court affairs had formerly been established, filled by members of the imperial clan at drafted-edict rank and above; when a post was vacant, a clan member at court-official rank and above managed vice-director duties.

sentences.zh: 掌奉諸廟諸陵薦享之事，司皇族之籍。

translations.literal: They managed offerings at all temples and tombs and kept the registers of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: They oversaw offerings at all temples and tombs and maintained the registers of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 主簿一員，以 京官充。

translations.literal: One registrar, filled by a capital official.
translations.idiomatic: There was one registrar, filled by a capital official.

sentences.zh: （舊自丞、簿以上，皆宗姓為之，通署寺事。

translations.literal: (Formerly from the vice director and registrar upward, all were of the imperial clan surname and jointly signed court business.
translations.idiomatic: (Formerly from the vice director and registrar upward, all were of the imperial clan surname and jointly signed court business.

sentences.zh: 初置卿、少，率命常參官判寺事 。

translations.literal: When the minister and vice minister were first established, regularly attending court officials were generally ordered to supervise court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the minister and vice minister were first established, regularly attending court officials were generally ordered to supervise court affairs.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符八年，以兵部侍郎趙安易兼卿，判寺趙世長改為知寺事。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Vice Minister of War Zhao Anyi was concurrently minister; Zhao Shichang, who had supervised the court, was changed to manager of court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In 1015 Vice Minister of War Zhao Anyi was made concurrent minister; Zhao Shichang, who had supervised the court, was redesignated manager of court affairs.

sentences.zh: 九年，始定丞、郎 以上兼卿，給、捨以下兼少卿，郎中以下兼丞，京官兼主簿。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, it was first fixed that vice directors and drafting officials and above would concurrently serve as minister, drafters and revisers and below as vice minister, department directors and below as vice director, and capital officials as registrar.
translations.idiomatic: In 1016 it was first fixed that vice directors and drafting officials and above would concurrently serve as minister, drafters and revisers and below as vice minister, department directors and below as vice director, and capital officials as registrar.

sentences.zh: 其卿闕，則丞以下行寺事 而無知、判之名。）〉

translations.literal: When the minister was vacant, vice directors and below conducted court business without the titles of manager or supervisor.)
translations.idiomatic: When the minister was vacant, vice directors and below conducted court business without the titles of manager or supervisor.)

sentences.zh: 元豐官制行，詔宗正長貳不專用國姓，蓋自有大宗正司以統皇族也 。

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng offices were instituted, an edict directed that the chief and deputy ministers of the Court of the Imperial Clan need not be exclusively of the imperial surname, since there was already the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch to govern the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yuanfeng offices took effect, an edict directed that the chief and deputy ministers of the Court of the Imperial Clan need not be exclusively of the imperial surname, for the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch already governed the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 渡江後，卿不常置，少卿一人，以太常兼。

translations.literal: After crossing the river, the minister was not regularly appointed; one vice minister, concurrently from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: After the crossing south, the minister was not regularly appointed; one vice minister served concurrently from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，復置少卿一人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, one vice minister was again established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1133 one vice minister was again established.

sentences.zh: 五年，復置丞 ；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the vice director was again established;
translations.idiomatic: In 1135 the vice director was restored;

sentences.zh: 十年，置主簿；

translations.literal: in the tenth year, the registrar was established;
translations.idiomatic: in 1140 the registrar was established;

sentences.zh: 隆興元年並省。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing, all were merged and cut.
translations.idiomatic: In 1163 all were merged and abolished.

sentences.zh: 次年，詔丞、簿復舊制。

translations.literal: The following year, an edict restored the vice director and registrar to the former system.
translations.idiomatic: The following year an edict restored the vice director and registrar to the former system.

sentences.zh: 嘉定九年，詔以宗學改隸宗 正寺，自此寺官又預校試之事。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Jiading, an edict directed that the Clan School be transferred to the jurisdiction of the Court of the Imperial Clan; from then on court officials also took part in examination affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In 1216 an edict placed the Clan School under the Court of the Imperial Clan; from then on its officials also took part in examination affairs.

sentences.zh: 分案二；

translations.literal: There were two sections;
translations.idiomatic: There were two sections;

sentences.zh: 曰屬籍，曰知雜。

translations.literal: Membership Registers, and Miscellaneous Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Membership Registers, and Miscellaneous Affairs.

sentences.zh: 吏額，胥長一人，胥史一人 ，胥佐二人，楷書二人，貼書二人。

translations.literal: Staff quota: one senior clerk, one clerk, two clerk-assistants, two regular-script copyists, two paste-up copyists.
translations.idiomatic: The staff quota was one senior clerk, one clerk, two clerk-assistants, two regular-script copyists, and two paste-up copyists.

sentences.zh: 大宗正司

translations.literal: Office of the Great Clan Patriarch
translations.idiomatic: Office of the Great Clan Patriarch

sentences.zh: 景祐三年始制司，以皇兄寧江軍節度使濮王知大宗正事，皇姪彰化軍節度觀察留後守節 同知大宗正事，元豐正名，仍置知及同知官各一人，選宗室團練、觀察使以上有德望者 充；

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingyou the office was first established; the emperor's elder brother, Prince Pu, military commissioner of Ningjiang Circuit, was appointed to know patriarchal affairs of the great clan; the emperor's nephew Shoujie, military commissioner and observation commissioner of Zhanghua Circuit with retention, was appointed co-manager; at Yuanfeng the formal name was fixed, and posts of one knowing director and one co-manager were still kept, filled from among deserving members of the imperial clan at regimental and observation commissioner rank and above;
translations.idiomatic: In 1036 the office was first established: the emperor's elder brother, Prince Pu, military commissioner of Ningjiang Circuit, was appointed to know patriarchal affairs of the great clan; his nephew Shoujie, military commissioner and observation commissioner of Zhanghua Circuit with retention, was appointed co-manager. At Yuanfeng the formal name was fixed, with one knowing director and one co-manager, chosen from deserving imperial clansmen at regimental commissioner and observation commissioner rank and above;

sentences.zh: 丞二人，以文臣京朝官以上充。

translations.literal: Two vice directors, filled by civil officials at court-official rank and above.
translations.idiomatic: two vice directors, filled by civil officials at metropolitan court-official rank and above.

sentences.zh: 掌糾合族屬而訓之以德行、道藝，受其詞訟而糾正 其愆違，有罪則先劾以聞；

translations.literal: They rallied the clan and instructed them in virtue and conduct and the arts of the Way, received their lawsuits and corrected transgressions, and when guilty first impeached and reported;
translations.idiomatic: They rallied the kindred, instructed them in virtue, conduct, and the arts of the Way, received their lawsuits and corrected transgressions, and when there was guilt first impeached and reported;

sentences.zh: 法例不能決者，同上殿取裁。

translations.literal: when precedent and statutes could not decide a case, they went up to the throne together for the decision.
translations.idiomatic: cases that statutes and precedents could not decide were taken up to the throne together for judgment.

sentences.zh: 若宮邸官因事出入，日書於籍 ，季終類奏。

translations.literal: When palace-resident officials went out on business, it was entered daily in the register; at quarter's end it was submitted by category.
translations.idiomatic: When palace-resident officials went out on business, it was entered daily in a register and submitted by category at quarter's end.

sentences.zh: 歲錄存亡之數報宗正寺。

translations.literal: Yearly they recorded numbers of the living and dead and reported to the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: Each year they recorded numbers of the living and dead and reported to the Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 凡宗室服屬遠近之數及其賞罰規式，皆總之。

translations.literal: All degrees of kinship among the imperial clan and the rules for rewards and punishments were under their general charge.
translations.idiomatic: All degrees of imperial-clan kinship and the rules for rewards and punishments were under their general charge.

sentences.zh: 官屬有記室一人，掌箋奏；

translations.literal: Among the staff was one recorder, managing memorials and submissions;
translations.idiomatic: Among the staff was one recorder, who managed memorials and submissions;

sentences.zh: 講書、教授十有二人，分位講授，兼領小學之事。

translations.literal: twelve lecturers and instructors, dividing posts to lecture, also overseeing primary-school affairs.
translations.idiomatic: twelve lecturers and instructors divided posts to lecture and also oversaw primary-school affairs.

sentences.zh: 舊制，擇 宗室賢者為知大宗正事，次一人為同知；

translations.literal: Under the old system, worthy members of the imperial clan were chosen to know patriarchal affairs of the great clan, and one next in rank as co-manager;
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, worthy imperial clansmen were chosen to know patriarchal affairs of the great clan, with one next in rank as co-manager;

sentences.zh: 其後，位高屬尊者為判。

translations.literal: later, one of higher rank and senior kinship served as supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: later, one of higher rank and senior kinship served as supervisor.

sentences.zh: 熙寧三年，始以異姓 朝臣二員知丞事，置局為睦親、廣親宅。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xining, two court officials of other surnames were first appointed to manage vice-director duties, and bureaus were established as the Lodgings of Kinship and the Lodgings of Broad Kinship.
translations.idiomatic: In 1070 two court officials of other surnames were first appointed to manage vice-director duties, and bureaus were established as the Lodgings of Kinship and the Lodgings of Broad Kinship.

sentences.zh: 是歲省管幹睦親、廣親宅及提舉郡、縣主等它 官，以其事歸宗正。

translations.literal: That year the superintendents of the Lodgings of Kinship and Broad Kinship and other offices such as the commissioners over commandery and county princesses were cut, and their duties returned to the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: That year the superintendents of the Lodgings of Kinship and Broad Kinship and other offices such as commissioners over commandery and county princesses were abolished, and their duties returned to the Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: （自熙寧中置丞，始以都官員外郎張稚圭為之。

translations.literal: (From Xining, when vice directors were first established, Zhang Zhigui, vice director of the Office of Revenue, was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Xining period, when vice directors were first established, Zhang Zhigui, vice director of the Office of Revenue, was appointed.

sentences.zh: 神宗疑用異姓，王 安石言：前代宗正固有用庶姓者，乃錄春秋時公侯大夫事。

translations.literal: Shenzong doubted using other surnames; Wang Anshi said that in past ages the Court of the Imperial Clan indeed sometimes used common surnames, and recorded affairs of dukes, marquises, grandees, and doctors of the Spring and Autumn period.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong doubted employing men of other surnames; Wang Anshi said that in earlier ages the Court of the Imperial Clan had indeed sometimes used commoners, and recorded affairs of dukes, marquises, grandees, and grand masters from the Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 神宗曰：「此雖無前代故事 ，行之何害？」

translations.literal: Shenzong said: "Although there is no precedent from earlier ages, what harm is there in carrying it out?"
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong said, "Although there is no precedent from earlier ages, what harm is there in carrying it out?"

sentences.zh: 安石曰：「聖人創法，不必皆循前代所已行者。」

translations.literal: Wang Anshi said: "When sages create institutions, they need not all follow what earlier ages already did."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said, "When sages create institutions, they need not all follow what earlier ages already did."

sentences.zh: 於是召稚圭對而命之。）〉

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhigui was summoned for audience and appointed.)
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Zhigui was summoned for audience and appointed.)

sentences.zh: 分案五，置吏十有一。

translations.literal: Five sections, with eleven clerks established.
translations.idiomatic: There were five sections and eleven clerks.

sentences.zh: 元豐五年，詔大宗正司不隸六曹，其丞屬中書省奏差。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yuanfeng, an edict directed that the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch not be subordinate to the Six Ministries; its vice directors were to be memorialized and appointed by the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In 1082 an edict directed that the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch not be subordinate to the Six Ministries; its vice directors were to be memorialized and appointed by the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 元祐四 年，詔宗室越本司訴事者罪之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanyou, an edict punished imperial clan members who bypassed this office to sue.
translations.idiomatic: In 1089 an edict punished imperial clansmen who bypassed this office to bring suit.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔宗正按熙寧敕諸院建小學，自八歲至十四歲， 首檢舉入學。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, an edict directed the Court of the Imperial Clan, following the Xining charter, to establish primary schools at each residence; from eight to fourteen years of age, they were first selected and entered school.
translations.idiomatic: In 1091 an edict directed the Court of the Imperial Clan, following the Xining charter, to establish primary schools at each residence; children from eight to fourteen were first selected and enrolled.

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年，詔袒免外兩世孤遺貧乏者，驗實廩給之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaosheng, an edict directed that for the isolated poor bereft two generations beyond bareheaded mourning, after verification grain allowance was given.
translations.idiomatic: In 1094 an edict directed grain allowance, after verification, for the isolated poor bereft two generations beyond bareheaded mourning.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔宗室若婦女 自外還京，並報宗正，崇寧三年，詔大宗正及外宗正司將條貫事跡關宗正寺，修纂圖牒 。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict directed that imperial clan members and women returning to the capital from outside all report to the Court of the Imperial Clan; in the third year of Chongning, an edict directed the Great Clan Patriarch and outer patriarch offices to compile charts and registers of regulations and deeds relating to the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1097 an edict required imperial clansmen and women returning to the capital from outside to report to the Court of the Imperial Clan. In 1104 an edict directed the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch and the outer patriarch offices to compile charts and registers of regulations and deeds relating to the Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 政和三年，詔以知大宗正事仲忽提舉宗子學事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe, an edict directed Zhong Hu, who knew patriarchal affairs of the great clan, to superintend the school for imperial sons.
translations.idiomatic: In 1113 an edict directed Zhong Hu, who knew patriarchal affairs of the great clan, to superintend the school for imperial sons.

sentences.zh: 崇寧三年，置南外宗正司於南京，西外宗正司於西京，各置敦宗院，初，講議司言：「 宗室疏屬原居兩京輔郡者，各置敦宗院，其兩京各置外宗正司。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongning, the Southern Outer Office of the Great Clan Patriarch was established at Nanjing and the Western Outer at Xijing, each with a Cherishing Clan Hall; initially the Deliberation Office said: "Distant imperial clan members who originally dwelt in the two capitals and auxiliary commanderies should each have a Cherishing Clan Hall established, and each capital should have an outer Office of the Great Clan Patriarch."
translations.idiomatic: In 1104 the Southern Outer Office of the Great Clan Patriarch was established at Nanjing and the Western Outer at Xijing, each with a Cherishing Clan Hall. Initially the Deliberation Office said, "Distant imperial clansmen who originally dwelt in the two capitals and auxiliary commanderies should each have a Cherishing Clan Hall, and each capital should have an outer Office of the Great Clan Patriarch."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 仍詔各擇宗室 之賢者一人為知宗，掌外居宗室，詔復定宗學博士、正錄員數。

translations.literal: Still an edict directed that in each place one worthy member of the imperial clan be chosen as director of the clan to govern resident clan members outside the capital, and the numbers of academy doctors and chief registrars of the clan school were re-fixed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also directed that in each place one worthy imperial clansman be chosen as director of the clan to govern clansmen residing outside the capital, and the numbers of academy doctors and chief registrars of the clan school were re-fixed.

sentences.zh: 大觀四年罷，政和二年 復舊。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Daguan it was abolished; in the second year of Zhenghe the old system was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In 1110 it was abolished; in 1112 the old system was restored.

sentences.zh: 又詔敦宗院宗子有文藝、行實眾所共知者，許外宗正官考察以聞。

translations.literal: Another edict directed that among sons of the clan in the Cherishing Clan Hall with literary skill and conduct known to all, outer patriarch officials might examine and report them.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict allowed outer patriarch officials to examine and report sons of the clan in the Cherishing Clan Hall whose literary skill and conduct were known to all.

sentences.zh: 中興後，以位高屬尊者為判大宗正事，其知及同知如舊制。

translations.literal: After the restoration, one of higher rank and senior kinship served as supervisor of patriarchal affairs of the great clan; the knowing director and co-manager were as in the old system.
translations.idiomatic: After the restoration, one of higher rank and senior kinship served as supervisor of patriarchal affairs of the great clan; the knowing director and co-manager followed the old system.

sentences.zh: 又置知大宗正丞一員，以文 臣充，掌糾合宗室而檢防訓飭之。

translations.literal: Also one vice director knowing patriarchal affairs of the great clan was established, filled by a civil official, rallying the imperial clan and inspecting, guarding, and admonishing them.
translations.idiomatic: One vice director knowing patriarchal affairs of the great clan was also established, filled by a civil official, to rally the imperial clan and inspect, guard, and admonish them.

sentences.zh: 凡南班宗室磨勘、遷轉、襲封、請給，覈其當否；

translations.literal: For all southern-bureau imperial clan merit reviews, transfers, succession to enfeoffment, and requests for grants, they verified whether appropriate;
translations.idiomatic: For all southern-bureau imperial-clan merit reviews, transfers, succession to enfeoffment, and requests for grants, they verified whether the matter was appropriate;

sentences.zh: 嫁 娶房奩、分析財產，酌厚薄多寡而訂其議。

translations.literal: for marriage trousseaux and division of property, they weighed more or less and settled the matter.
translations.idiomatic: for marriage trousseaux and division of property, they weighed more or less and settled the dispute.

sentences.zh: 凡宗室除合該賜名外，皆大宗正定名而後報 宗正寺。

translations.literal: Except where imperial clan members should by rule receive granted names, all names were fixed by the Great Clan Patriarch and then reported to the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: Except where imperial clansmen should by rule receive granted names, all names were fixed by the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch and then reported to the Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 其餘遷授官資、支給錢米，考覈以詔予奪。

translations.literal: Other promotions, salary grades, and disbursement of cash and grain were examined and granted or withheld by edict.
translations.idiomatic: Other promotions, salary grades, and disbursements of cash and grain were examined, then granted or withheld by edict.

sentences.zh: 其不率教者以法拘之，歲久知悔， 則除其過名。

translations.literal: Those not following instruction were restrained by law; when after long years they showed repentance, the record of offense was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Those who did not follow instruction were restrained by law; when after many years they showed repentance, the record of offense was removed.

sentences.zh: 復直南外宗正司、西外宗正司，以處宗室之在外者。

translations.literal: The Southern and Western outer Offices of the Great Clan Patriarch were restored to house imperial clan members outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern and Western outer Offices of the Great Clan Patriarch were restored to house imperial clansmen outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 各仍舊制設敦宗院， 皆設知宗，所在通判職官兼丞、簿，其糾合、檢防、訓飭如大宗正司。

translations.literal: Each still set up Cherishing Clan Halls as in the old system, all with directors of the clan; local military and civil officials concurrently served as vice directors and registrars, with rallying, inspection, and admonishment as in the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch.
translations.idiomatic: Each still set up Cherishing Clan Halls as in the old system, all with directors of the clan; local general controllers concurrently served as vice directors and registrars, with rallying, inspection, and admonishment as in the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch.

sentences.zh: 西、南外兩司闕 知宗，間令大宗正司選擇保明而後授之。

translations.literal: When the western and southern outer offices lacked a director of the clan, the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch was sometimes ordered to choose, vouch, and then appoint.
translations.idiomatic: When the western and southern outer offices lacked a director of the clan, the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch was sometimes ordered to choose, vouch, and then appoint.

sentences.zh: 又各置教授以課其行藝。

translations.literal: Instructors were also established in each place to examine their conduct and arts.
translations.idiomatic: Instructors were also established in each place to examine their conduct and arts.

sentences.zh: 南渡初，先徙宗室於 江、淮，於是大宗正司移江寧，南外移鎮江，西外移揚州。

translations.literal: At the start of the southern crossing, imperial clan members were first moved to the Yangtze and Huai; then the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch moved to Jiangning, the southern outer to Zhenjiang, the western outer to Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the southern crossing, imperial clansmen were first moved to the Yangtze and Huai regions; then the Office of the Great Clan Patriarch moved to Jiangning, the southern outer to Zhenjiang, and the western outer to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 其後屢徙，後西外止於福州 ，南外止於泉州；

translations.literal: They were moved repeatedly thereafter; later the western outer stopped at Fuzhou and the southern outer at Quanzhou;
translations.idiomatic: They were moved repeatedly thereafter; later the western outer settled at Fuzhou and the southern outer at Quanzhou;

sentences.zh: 又置紹興府宗正司，蓋初隨其所寓而分管轄之。

translations.literal: also an Office of the Imperial Clan at Shaoxing Prefecture was established, at first to govern according to where they resided.
translations.idiomatic: an Office of the Imperial Clan at Shaoxing Prefecture was also established, at first to govern according to where clansmen resided.

sentences.zh: 乾道七年，嘗欲移紹 興府宗司於蜀，不果，後並歸行在。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qiandao, they once wished to move the Shaoxing prefectural clan office to Shu; it did not succeed, and later all were merged back to the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In 1171 they once wished to move the Shaoxing prefectural clan office to Shu; the plan failed, and later all were merged back to the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 嘉定間，用臣僚言，乞凡除授知宗，須擇老成更練 之人。

translations.literal: During Jiading, following a memorial of officials, it was requested that all appointments as director of the clan select persons experienced and seasoned in years.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiading period, following officials' memorial, it was requested that all appointments as director of the clan select persons experienced and seasoned in years.

sentences.zh: 詔知宗正丞照百司例每日入局所，以示增重宗盟之意。

translations.literal: An edict directed the vice director knowing patriarchal affairs of the great clan to enter the office daily like the hundred bureaus, to show increased weight to the imperial kindred.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed the vice director knowing patriarchal affairs of the great clan to enter the office daily like the hundred bureaus, to show increased weight to the imperial kindred.

sentences.zh: 玉牒所

translations.literal: Jade Genealogy Office
translations.idiomatic: Jade Genealogy Office

sentences.zh: 淳化六年，始設局置官，詔以皇宋玉牒為名，建玉牒殿。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Chunhua the bureau was first established with officials; an edict took Imperial Song Jade Genealogy as the name and built the Jade Genealogy Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In 995 the bureau was first established with officials; an edict took Imperial Song Jade Genealogy as the name and built the Jade Genealogy Hall.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，命趙安易、梁周翰編 屬籍，始創規制。

translations.literal: At the start of Xianping, Zhao Anyi and Liang Zhouhan were ordered to compile the membership register, first creating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Xianping period, Zhao Anyi and Liang Zhouhan were ordered to compile the membership register, first creating regulations.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符六年，以知制誥劉筠、夏竦為修玉牒官，自後置一員或二員 。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, drafting-on-call Liu Yun and Xia Song were made jade genealogy compilers; thereafter one or two posts were kept.
translations.idiomatic: In 1013 drafting-on-call Liu Yun and Xia Song were made jade genealogy compilers; thereafter one or two posts were kept.

sentences.zh: 元豐官制行，分隸宗正寺官。

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng offices were instituted, they were placed under officials of the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yuanfeng offices took effect, they were placed under officials of the Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 寺丞王鞏奏：「玉牒十年一進，並以學士典領。

translations.literal: Court vice director Wang Gong memorialized: "The jade genealogy is submitted every ten years, always overseen by academicians.
translations.idiomatic: Court vice director Wang Gong memorialized, "The jade genealogy is submitted every ten years, always overseen by academicians.

sentences.zh: 自熙寧 中范鎮進書之後，神宗玉牒至今未修。

translations.literal: After Fan Zhen presented his book in Xining, Shenzong's jade genealogy has to this day not been revised.
translations.idiomatic: Since Fan Zhen presented his book in the Xining period, Shenzong's jade genealogy has to this day not been revised.

sentences.zh: 僊源類譜自慶曆中張方平修進之後，僅五十年， 並無成書。

translations.literal: The Genealogical Compendium of the Immortal Source has, since Zhang Fangping revised and presented it in Qingli, for nearly fifty years had no completed book.
translations.idiomatic: The Genealogical Compendium of the Immortal Source, since Zhang Fangping revised and presented it in the Qingli period, had for nearly fifty years produced no completed book.

sentences.zh: 乞別立法，其修玉牒及類譜官，每二年一具草繳進。」

translations.literal: I request separate legislation: compilers of the jade genealogy and classified genealogy should every two years submit a draft."
translations.idiomatic: I request separate legislation: compilers of the jade genealogy and classified genealogy should every two years submit a draft."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was adopted.

sentences.zh: 紹聖三年，應 宗室賜名，三祖下各隨祖宗之支子而下，雖兄弟數多，並為一字相連。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaosheng, responding to imperial clan name grants, under each of the three founding ancestors sons descended by branch, though brothers were many, all names were connected by one character.
translations.idiomatic: In 1096, responding to imperial-clan name grants, under each of the three founding ancestors sons descended by branch; though brothers were many, all names were linked by one character.

sentences.zh: 南渡後，紹興十 二年，始建玉牒所。

translations.literal: After the southern crossing, in the twelfth year of Shaoxing, the Jade Genealogy Office was first established.
translations.idiomatic: After the southern crossing, in 1142 the Jade Genealogy Office was first established.

sentences.zh: 提舉一人或二人，以宰相執政為之，以侍從官一人兼修，宗正卿、 少而下同修纂。

translations.literal: One or two superintendents, held by chancellors in government; one attendant-in-waiting concurrently revised; from the minister of the Court of the Imperial Clan downward all jointly compiled.
translations.idiomatic: One or two superintendents were held by chancellors in government; one attendant-in-waiting concurrently revised; from the minister of the Court of the Imperial Clan downward all jointly compiled.

sentences.zh: 先是，宗正寺丞邵大受奏：「講求宗正寺舊掌之書，曰皇帝玉牒，曰仙 源積慶圖，曰宗藩慶系錄，曰宗支屬籍。

translations.literal: Earlier, Court of the Imperial Clan vice director Shao Dashou memorialized: "Examining books formerly held by the Court of the Imperial Clan: the Emperor's Jade Genealogy, the Chart of Accumulated Felicity from the Immortal Source, the Record of Felicitous Lines of Enfeoffed Princes, the Membership Register of Clan Branches.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Court of the Imperial Clan vice director Shao Dashou memorialized, "Examining books formerly held by the Court of the Imperial Clan: the Emperor's Jade Genealogy, the Chart of Accumulated Felicity from the Immortal Source, the Record of Felicitous Lines of Enfeoffed Princes, and the Membership Register of Clan Branches.

sentences.zh: 南渡四書散失，今重加修纂仙源慶系屬籍總要 ，合圖、錄、屬籍三者而一之，既無愧於昔矣；

translations.literal: The four books were scattered and lost in the southern crossing; now the Essential Summary of Immortal Source Felicitous Lines and Membership is newly compiled, combining chart, record, and register in one—no shame to the past;
translations.idiomatic: The four books were scattered and lost in the southern crossing; now the Essential Summary of Immortal Source Felicitous Lines and Membership is newly compiled, combining chart, record, and register in one—without shame to the past;

sentences.zh: 獨玉牒一書未修，宜搜訪討論，以正九 族，以壯本支。」

translations.literal: only the jade genealogy book remains unrevised; it is fitting to search and discuss it, to rectify the nine kindreds and strengthen the root branch."
translations.idiomatic: only the jade genealogy remains unrevised; it is fitting to search and discuss it, to rectify the nine kindreds and strengthen the root branch."

sentences.zh: 於是始置官如舊制，分案五，置吏十。

translations.literal: Thereupon officials were established as in the old system, with five sections and ten clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon officials were established as in the old system, with five sections and ten clerks.

sentences.zh: 乾道八年，詔玉牒殿主管香火 ，差內侍三員、武臣一員充，並改作幹辦玉牒所殿。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qiandao, an edict directed the Jade Genealogy Hall to manage incense offerings, with three inner attendants and one military official appointed, and the name changed to Office of the Jade Genealogy Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In 1172 an edict directed the Jade Genealogy Hall to manage incense offerings, with three inner attendants and one military official appointed, and the name changed to Office of the Jade Genealogy Hall.

sentences.zh: 光祿寺 卿 少卿 丞

translations.literal: Court of Imperial Entertainments: Minister, Vice Minister, Vice Director
translations.idiomatic: Court of Imperial Entertainments: minister, vice minister, vice director

sentences.zh: 主簿各一人。

translations.literal: Registrar one each.
translations.idiomatic: Each office had one registrar.

sentences.zh: 卿掌祭祀、朝會、宴鄉酒醴膳羞之事，修其儲備而謹其出納之政，少卿為 之貳，丞參領之。

translations.literal: The minister managed sacrifices, court assemblies, banquets, village libations, food, drink, and delicacies, maintaining stores and carefully governing disbursement and receipt; the vice minister was second; the vice director assisted.
